crossRefs.note: “See now, behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.
who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.
He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.
He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the…
There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.

translations.web: Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.
translations.bsb: The hills yield him their produce, while all the beasts of the field play nearby.
translations.kjv: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, where all the beasts of the field play.
translations.asv: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, Where all the beasts of the field do play.
